name: Test Combat
summary: Initiative on the first line. Three characters, four goblins, one room. Ends when the fight does.
about:
A fight and nothing else, for trying hit points, conditions, dice and the approval queue without playing an evening first.

The party are already in the room and already seen. There is no lead-up and no aftermath: it starts on initiative and ends when one side is down.

Logins: marco / elsa / dana, password 'goblin-teeth'. The DM login is 'gm' with 'run-the-game'.

The goblins are shared with the party deliberately, so players can watch their hit points fall.

entities.name: Elara Nightwind
entities.summary: Wizard. Two spells and no armour.

entities.name: Yeemik
entities.summary: Goblin boss. Will bargain the moment it is losing.

data.motive: survive, and be in charge of whoever is left
data.secrets: Will offer to sell out the others at half health.
data.party_knows: The one shouting at the others.

entities.name: Goblin with the bow
entities.summary: On the ledge, out of reach.

data.party_knows: Up on the ledge with a bow.

entities.name: Goblin with the notched sword
entities.summary: Between the party and the door.

data.secrets: Will run at the first death.

entities.name: The Cave Mouth
entities.summary: Twenty feet across, a stream down the middle, a ledge on the left.

data.shared_notes: Wet stone, a stream you could slip in, and a ledge about ten feet up on the left.

facts.subject: boss
facts.object: once it is down to half

facts.subject: cave
facts.object: is difficult ground and knocks you prone on a failed save

storyline.title: Roll initiative
storyline.read_aloud: The bow comes up on the ledge before anyone has spoken. Yeemik is already shouting. Roll initiative.
storyline.done_when: Everyone has an initiative and the first turn is taken.

storyline.title: The fight
storyline.read_aloud: The stream is slick, the ledge is ten feet up, and the one in the rubbish has not moved yet.
storyline.done_when: Two goblins are down, or Yeemik is at half and starts bargaining.

storyline.title: It is over
storyline.read_aloud: Whatever is left of them is running, dead, or talking.
storyline.done_when: No goblin is still fighting. That is the end -- there is no aftermath in this one.
